t: Stabilize, Document, Create: A Real-World Software Release Workflow
s: This article details a real-world software release process, 'Stabilize, Document, Create', focusing on managing Git branches, troubleshooting deployments, and leveraging AI for documentation and process automation, specifically for the Pipulate software.
sub: Python packaging and distribution strategies (PyPI, Nix)
Git branch management and release synchronization
Automated commit message generation with LLMs
